refactor(launch): failures carry whole stderr and the ⚠ cell bounds its line; clicks, plugin install and the handler probe share the describer (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

Medium review: keeping only stderr's last line lost git's fatal and ps's
error before its usage; the display bound belongs where the line is drawn,
so the broken cell clips through the render layer's sanitizer and the viewer
keeps the whole text. Lane failures keep stdout, where their tools explain.
Spawn errors drop the internal tag; clicks and handoffs say why one way.

refactor(launch): one describer says why a launch failed and what the child said, for every caller (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

Review findings: callers ranked stderr, reason and error differently, so a
timed-out click dropped the timeout, a timed-out tmux or doctor probe dropped
its stderr, a rate-limited read repeated its tag, a signal kill named no
signal, and a failed read could draw 2000 characters inline. The launcher now
owns the text: why, plus the last stderr line bounded by code point.

feat(sources): a failed shell read carries the command's stderr; the launcher names its timeout (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

A shell source's failed read now ends in what the command wrote to
stderr, trimmed and shown by its last 2000 characters, on every arm but
an output flood or a failed pipe. A timeout result carries
`timed out after N s` from the launch's own bound, so the shell reader
and the daemon's runs read it instead of spelling it from constants of
their own.

feat(facts): the payload a template reads is composed from the document (#616)

* test(facts): pin the bar, the view's payload and check's payload per preset (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

Drawn from the daemon's session source over fixed owners at a fixed instant, so
composing the payload from the document can be judged against bytes: the bar
must not move, and the payload snapshot's diff is where the accepted
differences show. The payload-owners fakes hold their answers in observables,
as the real owners do, so a view's computed sees a lane land.

* feat(facts): the payload a template reads is composed from the document (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

The payload, the globals a draw builds its options from and the facts document
are one turn, stamped together in one reaction, so a draw never mixes a
document with a request or a pick it was not composed from. A turn takes its
closure and lanes from the view's one declaration. A turn that cannot be
stamped keeps the last one and surfaces as a warning in the bar's indicator.
A view that fails to open releases what it began. The check command stamps a
fixture document and composes through the same function; its hand-written
payload and checkToday are gone.

* docs(claude-md): checks run on the code under review, never on another commit to second-guess a threshold

* test(facts): payload tests assert an unread lane as pending, not a missing key (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

* fix(facts): a draw reads the client's hints off its turn; a repeated failure is one turn; unstamped projects its arms (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

* test(facts): a failed stamp and its recovery each wake the view (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

* test(facts): the session rig holds the source runs main moved onto RenderDeps (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)
